name: experience-ablation-m3-full-pack-arm-switch
title: Experience-ablation M3: full runtime-pack arm switch with experimentId override and control-arm retrieval blocking
description: Milestone M3 of docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md. Extend the existing render-gate (packages/main/src/core/experience-hint-surface.ts + hint-mode.ts, currently review-entrypoint advisory hints only) to the FULL runtime memory pack (core/playbook-runtime-memory.ts buildMemoryFreshnessPack/renderMemoryFreshnessPack) at all lifecycle entrypoints that render it today (story_create, story_advance, session_brief, host_handoff, done_prepare, done_closure, dev_memory_start), under an experimentId override: when an experiment arm context is active, the arm (control|treatment) overrides resolveHintMode; control computes and logs the pack but does not render it; treatment renders it identically to today. Add mechanical control-arm retrieval blocking at the single CLI choke point (cli-engine.ts, alongside enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate): retrieval/consumption commands (recall, dev_memory_*, playbook_*, learning_*) are refused on the control arm and every attempt is recorded as a protocol-violation event with a counter (plan section 9). Pack must keep authority=non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false on both arms; the arm must never enter issues/blocker computation or prompt hashes. Exit criteria (plan section 13 M3 row): control hides+logs pack; treatment shows+logs pack; retrieval attempts on control are blocked and recorded.
